protocol.objective: Maximize the reviewed merchant contribution after modeled operating costs; report effects on other merchants separately.
protocol.identicalInputs: Exactly the same frozen packet, forecasts, model candidates, action menu and execution guards.
protocol.policyChanges: Only the reviewed merchant changes its coupon policy. No further model fitting during the seven-day replay.
protocol.economicMistake: Action loses more than $5 mean merchant contribution versus KEEP_CURRENT and the paired replay 95% interval is entirely below zero. This is an outcome diagnostic, not a ground-truth reasoning label.
protocol.hindsightRegret: Difference from the best allowed action averaged over these same future tapes. Optimistic post-hoc diagnostic; never an achievable-agent claim.
protocol.costCaveat: No new paid API calls. Current-chat token usage/account charge and electricity are unmetered. Cost totals are explicitly modeled, with a chat-price sensitivity table. Benchmark replay time is evaluation overhead, not deployment cost.
protocol.accounting: Sales already reflect redeemed discounts. Deduct refunds, COGS, delivery, modeled fees and outreach once. Final pending refunds for evaluation orders are settled. No 14-day retention benefit is claimed.
protocol.paypal: All replay payments and fees are synthetic. Existing native sandbox samples prove integration only. No PayPal or Channel3 requests in this benchmark.
protocol.exclusions: No novelty claim, production ROI, live traffic experiment, adaptive tool selection, independent agent team, or blinded generalization proof.

actionContract.scope: One named merchant, seven simulated days, profit objective. All other merchants keep their existing policy.

actions.KEEP_CURRENT: Continue the existing model or fixed-rule fallback.
actions.PAUSE_OFFERS: Issue no coupons; organic purchases remain possible.
actions.USE_RECENT_MODEL: Use the shared, locally fitted recent model only if it passed the common validation gate.
actions.OFFER_5: Propose 5% coupons to eligible customers, subject to all execution guards.
actions.OFFER_10: Propose 10% coupons to eligible customers, subject to all execution guards.
actions.ESCALATE: Keep the current policy and request human review; modeled handling cost is charged.

actionContract.limits: A decision review, not adaptive evidence gathering or an autonomous multi-agent system.

limitations: The assistant authored the engine and rules. Sealing prevents post-outcome edits but does not make this blinded.
